title: main-menu settings.jsonc
description: Runtime configuration for the main-menu plugin. Mirrors the Settings struct in src/Config.hpp; missing keys fall back to their C++ defaults.

kind.description: command runs a console command as the player; link prints the URL to chat; section opens another plugin's menu.

label.description: A translation key, or literal text.

command.description: For command: one console command, such as mm_lvl.

section.description: For section: the id the plugin publishes, such as admin.

locale.description: Translation language; matches a file in configs/translations.

panorama.description: Draw the Panorama menu; clients without the layout get center HTML.

addonId.description: Workshop addon carrying the compiled layout; 0 requires nothing.

label.description: A translation key, or literal text.

icon.description: One of the names in panorama/screens/main_menu/icons.j2.
